description.en: The retention period of the classic network endpoint of the instance. Valid values: **14**, **30**, **60**, and **120**. Unit: day.

title.zh: 延长MongoDB实例的经典网络保留时长

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时实例须满足以下条件：
* 实例状态处于运行中。
* 实例的网络处于混访模式。

> 本接口适用于副本集实例和分片集群实例，暂不支持单节点实例。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that the instance meets the following requirements:

- The instance is in the Running state.

- The network of the instance is in hybrid access mode.

> This operation is supported by replica set instances and sharded cluster instances. This operation is not supported by standalone instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-db-instance-net-expire-time --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --connection-string dds-bpxxxxxxxx.mongodb.rds.aliyuncs.com --classic-expend-expired-days 30 --region cn-hangzhou
